exercises.title: News & Media — Reading
exercises.passage: A school newspaper is produced by a team of students. Articles are written, checked and published every Friday. Last week, an interview with a local athlete was printed on the front page. The editors always compare information from different sources before publishing.

questions.question: How often is the newspaper published?
What appeared on the front page last week?
